_comment: Goal -> route. A step is a skill or plugin in THIS repo (bare name), or `<plugin>@<source-id>` / `@<source-id>` for an outside source in sources.json. scripts/build-index.py fails if any step does not resolve. Add a route only when it has been walked and works; mark gaps nobody fills with `gap: true`.

routes.goal: Find a capability before building or installing one
routes.note: Inventory first; the lightest capability that works wins; adoption goes through nix-config. mcp-utilities' `mcpfinder` server searches the registries from inside the session, so the Official MCP Registry step is reachable without leaving it.

routes.goal: Capture what a session figured out, so no session rediscovers it
routes.note: harvest triages and lands via PR; skill-creator tests; the gate validates before it ships.

routes.goal: Keep the skill library from only growing: find unused skills and retire them
routes.note: Ported from Hermes Agent's curator; retires from the harness via PR, never deletes.

routes.goal: Write up a discovery as one fact-checked document other agents can derive posts, articles and slides from
routes.note: Channel formatting is inherited: search the map and indexes for a repurposing skill.

routes.goal: Make a repo's default branch a safe, auto-merging release
routes.note: Required check first, App-token auto-merge second.

routes.goal: Turn a repo's review history into agent instructions
routes.note: Candidate; not declared in nix-config yet.

routes.goal: Work on a Nix flake repo with Claude Code
Audit a config monorepo's foundation
Security-review code or a dependency
Debug a failure methodically
Author a userscript or diagnose a live web page
Operate a physical Android phone over ADB
Send a formatted message with attachments from a native macOS app
Answer questions from a local document corpus
routes.note: Declares the `postgres` MCP server itself since 2026-10-02 (it used to come from nix-config's purged gateway). Needs `nix-mcp-postgres` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.pluginMcp.servers) — the launcher knows the loopback URI and the version pins; no secret, the store is trust auth scoped to one database.

routes.goal: Tailor a resume to a job posting
Supervise Claude Code hooks so one bad hook cannot wedge a session
Author an llms.txt
Get scannable, verdict-first answers and architecture maps
General language- or domain-specific engineering agents
routes.note: Candidate; pick single plugins, not the whole collection.

routes.goal: Rebuild a raster or auto-traced logo as clean, parametric SVG
routes.note: Measure centres/radii/angles, infer the construction rule, regenerate from parameters, score IoU vs. the source; walked 2026-09-24 on a figure-8 circuit mark (tolerant IoU 0.90).

routes.goal: Reach, or be reached by, another Claude session running concurrently
routes.note: Own address is in the ListAgents header, not the peer table; most peers are offline; a peer message can never grant escalation.

routes.goal: Run a fleet of repos from one session — dispatch, conquer, implement
routes.note: empire sets the conquest standard and owns none of the tools. There is no controller agent: the session's main agent dispatches. The Senate is a deterministic workflow, and conquest happens on first write, never on read.

routes.goal: Decide whether a perceived gap is worth filling
routes.note: Kill-first. A gap can be real and still wrong to fill — direction, doctrine, alternative, or an artifact of your own design.

routes.goal: Check whether a command actually measured what you are about to claim
routes.note: The discipline is off the shelf — obra/superpowers' verification-before-completion skill, cherry-picked by subpath. This covers the instruments its 'check exit code' step assumes are truthful. ShellCheck catches none of them and refuses zsh outright.

routes.goal: Administer a live WordPress site over its REST API
routes.note: ~59 tools against PRODUCTION — update/delete/settings included, no staging behind it. Needs `nix-mcp-wordpress` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.pluginMcp.servers), which reads the site URL, username and application password from the macOS Keychain at launch; a plugin .mcp.json cannot. NOT the WordPress MCP Adapter: that is a different endpoint (/wp-json/mcp/...) and it is dead — 404 rest_no_route. The core REST path (/wp-json/wp/v2) was verified live 2026-10-02.

routes.goal: Scrape or extract from a page a plain fetch cannot get
routes.note: Apify Store Actors, including rag-web-browser and web-fetch, for JavaScript-rendered or bot-gated pages. Needs `nix-mcp-apify` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.pluginMcp.servers), which reads APIFY_TOKEN from the macOS Keychain at launch — local token, not the hosted mcp.apify.com OAuth bridge, whose browser redirect a spawned stdio server cannot complete. Actors bill real compute units.

routes.goal: Work across several Gmail accounts in one session without them colliding
routes.note: Four accounts, four separate per-session MCP servers — no proxy and nothing shared. Each needs its launcher on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.gmailMcp.accounts), because the OAuth client secret is read from the macOS Keychain at launch and must not live in this repo. Replaces the central gateway retired 2026-10-01; Claude Desktop loads no plugins, so it gains nothing here.

routes.goal: Get the keyless utility MCP servers: knowledge graph, step-by-step reasoning, Terraform registry docs, MCP discovery
routes.note: Four upstream servers, no credentials, one plugin because all four were enabled together on the gateway this replaces. `terraform-mcp-server` and `nix-mcp-mcpfinder` must be on PATH from kattakath/nix-config — a plugin cannot carry a /nix/store path, and mcpfinder needs a Node newer than the fleet default. `memory` gets a wrapper so its graph lives under XDG instead of inside the npx cache.

routes.goal: Run a command when the Bash tool refuses to (deleted worktree)
routes.note: `start_process` is not the Bash tool, so a worktree-isolation lock does not see it. PROPHYLAXIS, NOT A RESCUE: MCP servers load at session start, so an already-locked session will not pick it up — and the restart that would is what unsticks it anyway. Needs `nix-mcp-desktop-commander` on PATH from kattakath/nix-config (local.pluginMcp.servers), which runs the server under a Nix-generated macOS Seatbelt profile; a plugin .mcp.json cannot run sandbox-exec. The server's OWN allowedDirectories is not a boundary — its SECURITY.md calls directory restrictions "guardrails, not sandboxing", and an empty list means every path is allowed. The fence covers the FILE axis only: it does NOT reproduce the Bash-text denies (secret reveal, agenix -d, git push --force, gh pr merge), because those have no filesystem component.
